resources.string: Nexora Git uses GitHub's official authorization page. Passwords, passkeys and 2FA are handled only by GitHub.
Authentication is disabled in this build until the GitHub App client ID, broker URL and callback URL are configured.
A complete Android workspace for local Git and GitHub development.
Create, clone or import a project, then browse code and use the full local Git workflow.
Search repositories, users and code using the active GitHub account.
Review recent account activity and open the GitHub notification inbox when needed.
GitHub authentication uses the official web flow. Nexora Git never asks for your GitHub password or passkey.
Product preferences are stored locally on this device. Credentials are never stored in general settings.
Use Android system colors when supported.
Require explicit confirmation before a force-with-lease operation that can rewrite remote history.
Durable large downloads and clones wait for an unmetered network.
GitHub accounts and encrypted sessions are managed from Profile.
OAuth uses PKCE and a verified HTTPS App Link. Tokens remain encrypted with Android Keystore.
Stable releases are blocked until a qualified beta/RC passes the release matrix.
Nexora Git stores repository data locally and does not place GitHub credentials in general preferences.
CI, signing identity and release provenance are verifiable from the public repository and release artifacts.
Open-source Android Git and GitHub workspace by Ghost Developer.
Nexora Git combines local Git and GitHub. Local repositories live on your device; GitHub authentication only grants the permissions needed for remote operations.
Sign-in opens GitHub in a secure browser flow. Nexora Git never asks for your GitHub password, passkey or 2FA code.
Cloned and imported projects are stored in app-controlled workspaces so local editing and Git operations continue offline when possible.
